mapper.select: select m.movie_id, m.movie_title, m.movie_genre, m.running_time, m.ticket_price, m.release_date, r.reservation_id, r.customer_name, r.movie_id, r.reservation_date, r.seat_number, r.ticket_count, r.reservation_status, m.ticket_price * r.ticket_count AS total_price from reservation inner join movie on r.movie_id = m.movie_id
